text:
sam: FYI customer on Dedicated (VPC, ALB -> Istio ingress) seeing 403s when using SSO-backed sessions. Works on Hosted. Root cause looks like our auth header is missing at the service.
eli: Can you paste the failing curl + headers (redact token)?
sam: repro steps: curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <opaque-sso-token>" "https://dedicated-customer.example/api/v1/generate" -> 403. On the pod we see no Authorization header.
sam: quick debug: added a health endpoint to echo request headers, pod shows: 
```
{
  "headers": {
    "x-forwarded-for": "10.0.0.12",
    "cookie": "session=abc...",
    "x-envoy-external-address": "1.2.3.4"
  }
}
```
eli: Interesting — Authorization totally gone. Which LB in front? ALB with proxy-protocol? Any inline rewrite rules?
sam: ALB -> nginx L7 proxy (customer managed) -> Istio ingress (our sidecar) -> Service. Customer says nginx is passthrough. They also use SignedCookie for SSO and our router shows both cookie + Authorization in incoming request, but Istio ext_authz returns OK then upstream drops it.
devon: This rings a bell. We had an Envoy filter that normalizes headers and strips duplicates. If cookie contains a bearer token we previously moved it to x-forwarded-authorization; check envoyfilter config on the ingress gateway.
sam: grep on istio-ingress-config shows custom envoyfilter: 
```
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1alpha3
kind: EnvoyFilter
metadata:
  name: rewrite-auth-forward
spec: ...
```
sam: The filter has: remove_headers: ["authorization"] then add_header: {"x-forwarded-authorization":"%AUTH%"} — looks like %AUTH% not being set when Authorization arrives as TLS-bumped cookie -> token binding.
eli: Does the ext_authz service respond with any header we should consume? Maybe it returns `x-ext-authz-authorization` and the filter expects a different name.
devon: Can you capture the ingress gateway raw request before ext_authz? Use tcpdump on host or add listener access logging: `istioctl proxy-config log istio-ingressgateway-xxxx --level trace` but easier: add a short Lua filter to dump headers.
sam: Did a tcpdump and confirmed the client TLS -> nginx forwards an HTTP/1.1 request with Authorization header present. At Istio, just before the ext_authz hook it is present. After ext_authz, and after our envoyfilter, the header disappears. Logs from ext_authz: `200 OK` and response headers include `x-authz-claims: user=abc;aud=redwood:d`
nisha: Could be header casing or header fragmentation. ALB sometimes splits long headers into multiple lines which Envoy concatenates differently; signed cookies sometimes create long header values. Also check `use_remote_address`/`preserve_external_request_id` flags.
devon: Also check `strip_headers` and `add_request_headers` in EnvoyFilter patch. If the patch uses `remove` then later `add` it might be clobbering because the add uses a variable that is only set by ext_authz when auth is a bearer in Authorization, not when it's in cookie.
eli: Quick hotfix: change rewrite rule to copy `authorization` to `x-forwarded-authorization` only if present, and avoid unconditional `remove_headers`. Can you try toggling on staging ingress?
sam: Pushed a patch to staging ingress filter that copies instead of remove+add. Repro: curl still 403 on production but staging now returns 200 and service sees Authorization forwarded as `x-forwarded-authorization`.
sam: Patch snippet used: 
```
- remove_headers: ["authorization"]
+ // copy if present, keep original otherwise
+ set_request_headers: {"x-forwarded-authorization": "%REQ(AUTHORIZATION)%"}
```
opsbot: deploy-bot: Deployed envoyfilter/rewrite-auth-forward to cluster: staging (revision: a12) by sam.
eli: Good sign. For prod we need a safer rollout: canary the EnvoyFilter by namespace label and monitor 5xx. Add telemetry to surface when Authorization header drops.
devon: Also verify that ext_authz isn't rewriting Authorization to `x-ext-auth` and returning it in allowed response — we prefer explicit header mapping. I'll open infra PR to make the filter tolerant to tokens in cookies and in headers (look up `cookie` header and extract token if matches regex).
sam: Customer on support call now — told them we identified the filter as culprit and working on patch. They asked for temporary workaround: they can configure nginx to inject `x-forwarded-authorization` with the token.
nisha: Follow-up: we should add an automated test that sends long tokens via cookie and Authorization and asserts the pod sees the header. Add to our ingress e2e harness.
sam: Created ticket INC-5938 with repro steps and quick patch link. Will schedule prod rollout with eli/devon tomorrow 09:00 UTC.
eli: Thanks. If anyone hits the same symptoms, search filter name `rewrite-auth-forward` and check for `remove_headers: ["authorization"]` and unguarded `add_header`.
devon: Also documenting a checklist: 1) confirm Authorization at tcpdump -> 2) confirm ext_authz response headers -> 3) check EnvoyFilter patches -> 4) attempt staging patch -> 5) canary rollout.
sam: closing loop with customer once prod rollout done. :thumbsup:
